FLAGS (R1-R6 do not settle): (1) Daikin Phoenix: cooling skids/modular central plants sit under rule 5 (no welded frame stated), but the site also produces rack containment in-house (rule-1 containment frames) and prefab modular data-center systems; written as base under R1 and flagged. (2) CMS Cooling: 'Modular Data Centers' is only a product-list label; excluded under rule 5 following p-modine-franklin-wi (stated ability to build modular data centers = recheck lead). (3) UPS, PDU and inverter cabinet plants (Eaton PDI Richmond x2, MEPPI Warrendale, Myers EPS Bethlehem, Active Power, Alpha) are not rule-1 and not clearly rule-4; left screened_no_evidence or lead. (5) R3 wording: I wrote an excluded record only where a site-level source was read and showed no welding (ASCO Lexington); rule-4 sites with nothing read stay screened_no_evidence or lead, as C3-1/-2 did. (6) JTS 'Abilene' OSHA record at 274 County Road 287, Merkel TX vs p-jts-abilene-tx at 2631 FM 3034, Abilene: same plant or second site not settled (lead). (7) Trystar Houston site tie rests on the TPMG Houston HQ statement plus the OSHA record name Trystar TPMG, LLC at 6919 Mayard Rd.
